english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for everyone in the relevant group, especially in conversation.
Use this as the all-purpose collective word for everybody.
Use this as the all-purpose choice for everyone in a shared group or audience.
Use this when addressing everyone present, especially where English says “we all” or “everyone.”
